title: Cross-disciplinary learning pilot
objective: Prepare four discipline-specific learning studios that test a shared AI-era learning cycle while preserving disciplinary evidence standards.

packages.title: Develop scientific inquiry studio
acceptance: Pendulum investigation has explicit variables, procedure, model assumptions, uncertainty, and limits.
Data are sourced or generated through a reproducible protocol and provenance is recorded.
Safety and accessible alternatives are documented.
Assessment includes independent explanation and a transfer probe.

packages.title: Develop engineering design studio
acceptance: Paper-bridge challenge defines facilitator-set constraints and fair test conditions.
Prototype iteration and failure analysis are observable.
Safety and accessible alternatives are documented.
Assessment distinguishes design rationale from measured performance.

packages.title: Develop humanities evidence studio
acceptance: Task uses attributable primary sources and contextual scholarship selected for the learner context.
Authorship, provenance, purpose, missing perspectives, and uncertainty are addressed.
No invented quotations, citations, or historical claims.
Sensitive topics and cultural restrictions trigger qualified review.

packages.title: Develop creative production studio
acceptance: Learner brief defines audience, intention, medium, and revision process.
Originality and craft are evaluated without reducing creativity to a single score.
AI-generated assets and licensed materials are attributable.
Accessibility and factual-check requirements are included where applicable.

packages.title: Design cross-studio assessment and transfer probes
acceptance: Common explain, perform, verify, transfer, create/account modes are mapped to discipline-specific evidence.
Transfer probes change meaningful conditions and do not rely on trick questions.
Scoring guidance records uncertainty and reviewer disagreement.
No unsupported claims of validity or efficacy are made.

packages.title: Prepare pilot ethics, accessibility, and data protocol
acceptance: Consent, data minimization, retention, anonymization, and publication permissions are explicit.
Accessibility alternatives are specified for each studio.
Age, institutional, and jurisdictional requirements are identified rather than assumed.
No learner recruitment begins before required approvals.

packages.title: Integrate and adversarially review the cross-disciplinary pilot
acceptance: All four studio briefs meet the common tutorial specification and retain field-specific standards.
Contradictions, missing prerequisites, unsafe steps, and unsupported claims are recorded.
Readiness gates are checked with evidence; unresolved blockers remain visible.
Pilot status remains proposed until actual learner activity and analysis are completed.
